result:
Compiled successfully. Created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/InstantsAgentTest.java` covering all four methods of `Instants`:

- **`toEpochMillis`** — epoch, null-as-epoch, positive/negative values, and overflow clamping at `Instant.MIN`/`Instant.MAX` to `Long.MIN_VALUE`/`Long.MAX_VALUE`.
- **`toInstant(Instant)`** — passthrough of a non-null instant, and null → `Instant.EPOCH`.
- **`toInstant(Instant, Instant)`** — non-null instant ignores default, null instant returns default, both null returns null, non-null instant with null default.
- **`toMillisSince`** — null/epoch behave like "now minus epoch" (bounded against `System.currentTimeMillis()` with tolerance), a past instant gives a positive bounded result, a future instant gives a negative result, and `Instant.MIN`/`Instant.MAX` clamp to `Long.MAX_VALUE`/`Long.MIN_VALUE` respectively.
